WATCH: Biden staffer shuts down interview before Biden can screw it up!
Jul. 22, 2020 1:27 pm
by
The Right Scoop
I normally don’t like some of the petty stuff the RNC posts of Biden mispronouncing a word or clearing his throat. I think it makes the RNC look bad to reasonable people. But this video the RNC just posted is something that I do like. It’s a Biden staffer shutting down an interview before Biden screws it up:
In this very short video you see Biden emphatically saying
“Sick! What’s with this guy?!”
, when all of a sudden the video feed is cut and a staffer tells the newser that they are out of time and the interview is over.
That is hilarious, but even more so it’s concerning that Biden would have to be managed this closely by his staffers. They literally cut the feed on him when it looked like he was about to go on a rant of some kind about, presumably, Trump.
It just goes to show that he isn’t ready for prime time. It honestly wouldn’t surprise me if Biden “de Bergerac” has someone in his ear telling him what to say in real time.
